Training and courses

Two ways to work together: training built for your teams, or courses that are part of school and university programmes.

In-house training9 in-house courses for 2026: agentic AI, the AI Act, DORA, NIS2, FinOps, SRE, SLA/OLA/UC. Programme, duration and deliverables defined by Metafive.ai.Courses for schools and universitiesBachelor's and Master's modules in governance, infrastructure, projects and security. Duration and content set by the programme leads.

In-house training

The topics IT teams need to master this year: AI moving into production, regulation coming into application, and costs that need to be controlled. Each course is built on your own services and ends with deliverables you can use the next day.

In-house
6 to 12 participants from the same organisation, working on your real cases.
On site or remote
On site in the Paris region, or remote in half-day sessions.
Three languages
In French, English or Arabic; materials in French or English.
Tailored
Programme adjusted after a scoping interview; courses can be combined into tracks.

Assessment

Placement questionnaire before the course, knowledge assessment at the end, certificate of attendance. Workshop deliverables are reviewed by the trainer.

These courses do not prepare for official certification exams and are not legal advice: they focus on putting things into practice. Regulatory content is updated for every session.

Courses for schools and universities

For engineering schools, digital schools, universities and continuing education. I teach the modules below with real cases drawn from 30 years of running infrastructure and services in Europe and the Middle East.

How it works

Your programme
Duration, content, objectives and assessment are set by the institution and the certification framework.
Levels
Bachelor's, Master's, MSc, university Master's, continuing and executive education.
Formats
Lectures, tutorials, real case studies, supervised projects, exam panels. Compatible with work-study schedules.
Languages
In French or English; Arabic possible. On site in the Paris region or remote.

Modules

Governance and service management

ITIL v2, v3 and 4, ISO/IEC 20000, the SLA, OLA, UC chain.

  • Infrastructure governance (ITIL)
  • Service delivery: catalogue, SLA, OLA, UC
  • IT Service Management (ITSM)
  • Support management
  • Release management and continuous improvement
  • IT Asset Management (ITAM)
  • Sustainable IT: FinOps and efficiency

Infrastructure design and management

Cloud, hybrid and platforms at scale.

  • Cloud and hybrid infrastructure design
  • Automation and software factory (CI/CD, Platform Engineering)
  • Identity and access management (IAM)

Project management and change

Transformation programmes, multicultural teams, budgets.

  • Pre-project study
  • Requirements and tenders
  • Project management
  • People management
  • Cost management
  • Acceptance testing management
  • Service contracts: service commitments and penalties
  • Professional communication

Security, compliance and audit

ISO 27001, ISO 22301, DORA, NIS2, AI Act: the governance side.

  • Infrastructure audit and compliance
  • Security policy
  • Security management and business continuity
  • Secure infrastructure architecture
  • Organisational security audit
  • Multilingual regulatory and cyber watch

Supervised projects and panels

End-to-end supervision, on topics close to real operations.

  • Projects: service management, infrastructure design and management
  • Projects: project management, support management
  • Projects: infrastructure audit, compliance side
  • Certification exam and professional project panels

Penetration testing, SOC work, forensics and hands-on SIEM tooling are not part of what I teach: I can co-teach them with a technical expert.

A worked example: identity and access management (IAM)

A module as I build it from the institution's module description: target competencies, learning objectives, outline, exercises and deliverables. Each sequence combines input, real cases and a workshop with a deliverable.

Foundations and models

Stakes, actors and risks; centralised, decentralised and federated models.

  • Workshop: risk audit of an existing system
  • Workshop: reasoned choice of a model for an organisation

Processes and technologies

Provisioning, deprovisioning, access management and access reviews; directories, federation and SSO, MFA.

  • Workshop: plan for the identity management processes
  • Workshop: choice of building blocks and implementation plan

Compliance and audit

GDPR, ISO 27001, NIST SP 800-63; monitoring, audit and corrective actions.

  • Workshop: compliance audit plan
  • Peer presentations and assessment

Real cases I bring

  • The Abu Dhabi e-Government Portal and Single Sign-On programme
  • Accounts, roles and logging in a multi-account AWS environment
  • Access control as seen by the ISO 27001 auditor

Teaching methods

Interactive lectures built on real cases, guided workshops with deliverables, flipped classroom, formative assessment (quizzes, cross-audits, peer review), a project running through the year.

Teaching experience

  • Teaching since 1998: computer applications and training programmes at the Institute of Administrative Development in Doha.
  • Trainer at the 15th Asian Games in Doha (2006): induction and general training sessions, leadership programme; more than 31,500 people trained by the programme.
  • Founded the first Microsoft e-Learning academy in the Gulf: more than 1,000 IT professionals trained.
  • “From SLI to SLO” video series, workshops and an “SRE Champions” community inside a major French banking group.
